summary: Enforce path-mount parity between customer domains and EKODI internal mounts, and require slashless/trailing-slash parity for all descendant routes.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed that route-matching errors and trailing-slash/non-trailing-slash divergence be enforced as repeat-prevention forced execution rules.

requirements: External customer-domain paths and internal EKODI mount paths must serve the same logical surface.
Descendant route suffixes must be preserved across mounts.
Root-absolute links that can escape an internal mount are forbidden.
Navigation and authentication returns must preserve the initiating host and mount.
Customer-domain routes must never collapse to the EKODI root or My EKODI unless explicitly requested.
Slashless and trailing-slash variants of every site root, admin, board and descendant route must resolve to the same logical surface.
Authentication realm, authorization context, canonical host and mount must remain identical across slash variants.
Either an HTTP 308 canonical redirect or equivalent direct resolution is permitted.
Content divergence between slash variants blocks validation and deployment.

verification: external and internal production route verification
